mapper.select: SELECT question_id AS questionId, MAX(question_type) AS questionType, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS wrongStudentCount, COALESCE(SUM(wrong_count), 0) AS totalWrongTimes FROM lp_wrong_record WHERE class_id = #{classId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY question_id ORDER BY totalWrongTimes DESC, wrongStudentCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT wp.point_id AS pointId, COUNT(DISTINCT wr.question_id) AS wrongQuestionCount, COALESCE(SUM(wr.wrong_count), 0) AS totalWrongTimes FROM lp_wrong_record wr INNER JOIN lp_wrong_point wp ON wp.wrong_id = wr.wrong_id AND wp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE wr.class_id = #{classId} AND wr.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY wp.point_id ORDER BY totalWrongTimes DESC

SELECT student_id AS studentId, wrong_count AS wrongCount, wrong_type AS wrongType, is_resolved AS isResolved, last_wrong_at AS lastWrongAt FROM lp_wrong_record WHERE class_id = #{classId} AND question_id = #{questionId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY wrong_count DESC, last_wrong_at DESC

SELECT COALESCE(wrong_type, 'UNKNOWN') AS wrongType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM lp_wrong_record WHERE class_id = #{classId} AND question_id = #{questionId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY wrong_type ORDER BY count DESC
